records.rationale: A delegation clause: it introduces no semantics and forwards to the lifecycle-script and parallel-execution rules of devcontainerjson-reference and devcontainer-reference, which are inventoried as their own clauses and dispositioned there (bhv-up-lifecycle-command-forms, bhv-up-exec-parity). Asserting it separately would re-observe another clause's evidence rather than a distinct consumer behavior.
Descriptive/informative prose; carries no directly testable consumer-runtime obligation.

An explicit non-requirement: it relieves an implementation of keeping Feature install scripts past the initial build. Because it neither requires nor forbids anything, both persisting and discarding the scripts satisfy it, so no observation can distinguish a conforming implementation from a non-conforming one.

An editorial note recording that this proposal deliberately leaves `initializeCommand` out of the Feature-contributed lifecycle set pending a secure design. It documents the proposal's own scope rather than an implementation rule, and deacon's FeatureMetadata models no `initializeCommand` at all (crates/core/src/features.rs models onCreate through postAttach only), so there is no Feature-contributed host hook to run or refuse.
